skills.description: Generates complete NHANES-style cross-sectional epidemiology + retrospective clinical validation research designs from a user-provided disease and biomarker direction. Always use this skill whenever a user wants to design, plan, or build a population-level biomarker association study using NHANES or similar survey datasets, especially when the article logic includes disease definition, biomarker formula derivation, multivariable logistic regression, restricted cubic spline analysis, subgroup stability testing, and a secondary hospital-based retrospective validation cohort. Covers five study patterns (cross-sectional association, dose-response / RCS, subgroup-stability, NHANES + retrospective validation, preliminary screening-performance) and always outputs four workload configs (Lite / Standard / Advanced / Publication+) with recommended primary plan, step-by-step workflow, figure plan, validation strategy, minimal executable version, publication upgrade path...

skills.description: 甲状腺癌主动监测（甲友吧），为甲状腺结节患者提供主动监测相关的科普参考与指南知识问答。整合 ATA 2025/NCCN 2025/KTA 2025/CACA 2025/KSThR 2024/JAES 2024/CMA 2023 等多部权威指南，采用 C-TIRADS 2023/ACR TI-RADS 超声分类标准。触发词：主动监测、甲状腺结节观察、微小癌随访、穿刺指征、TIRADS、甲状腺癌不手术、甲友吧。开发者：Rex，公众号：甲友吧，微信：Rexsky2025。
skills.description_zh:
甲状腺癌主动监测（甲友吧），是微信公众号「甲友吧」博主 Rex 为甲状腺结节患者打造的主动监测科普参考与指南知识问答工具。
开发者：Rex，微信公众号：甲友吧，开发者微信：Rexsky2025

本项目整合多部国内外权威指南与超声分类标准，为患者提供基于循证医学的主动监测决策参考，帮助患者科学理解甲状腺结节/微小癌的随访、观察与管理路径。

**English:**
Thyroid Cancer Active Surveillance Assistant is an educational tool developed by Rex, creator of the WeChat public account "甲友吧" (Thyroid Friends Club). It provides evidence-based information and guideline-based Q&A on active surveillance for patients with thyroid nodules.

The tool synthesizes multiple authoritative clinical guidelines and ultrasound classification standards to help patients understand the follow-up, observation, and management pathways for thyroid nodules and microcarcinomas.
skills.name: 甲状腺癌主动监测助手（甲友吧）
